inputs.name: Matev units argument
inputs.quote: The reasoning is that 1/X1 is high (due to 1/B1 being high), so it very generous for the estimation of X2 to use the A1 value as an estimate for A2 even though A1 isn't why 1/X1 is high.

inputs.name: LTEE generations per day
inputs.cite: parameters ltee.generations_per_day (also Z23003785 p.4; verified: false)

day.reading: G_f is in generations, so generation time is not a factor; A2 = A1

critic.reading: the LTEE's high per-year rate comes from short B1, not low A1, so it says nothing about A2 against A1
critic.why_none: Matev states no A2; the position is that A2 >= A1 is unshown, which has no figure to check

notes: Both readings agree on the arithmetic: X = A x B and X2/X1 = (A2/A1)(B2/B1). The dispute is A2/A1, which no held source measures; the statement claims no number for it, so the object is resolved, not blocked.
